Title: The Untamed Garden

ObjectiveProposalResponse: The Blight has only surfaced in recent years on Aeternum, while<g id="female_thosepeasants" /> clashes between the Angry Earth and Corruption have occurred for centuries.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Good work<g id="male_complimentplayer" /> in the ruins up there. If the Angry Earth were spawned after the first war with Corruption,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> they may well hold the secret to defeating it.

Title: On the Wizard's Trail
Description: Having reached the safety of the traveler's camp, Sun resolves to learn what she can before traveling to the settlement.\nAccompany Morgaine to the north in search of evidence of Myrddin's fate.

DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: There... his voice<g id="female_lookaroundWonder" /> again, speaking as if he knew I'd come, and left some riddle… how? What games do you play, brother?

Title: The Hope of New Growth
Description: While Morgaine remains in the Crystal Cave, Sun takes the opportunity to further explore the mysteries of the Angry Earth.\nAccompany Sun on her exploration of the crater.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Myrddin<g id="female_impatient" /> was obsessed with the Ancients' methods of sundering the souls of their guardians.
InProgressResponse: Meet with Sun and let<g id="female_crossarms" /> her know what we have found. Her focus is on the Angry Earth, but mine is on my brother, as it should be.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_gestureRightM" />Now, I think we've finally found something useful. The whispers<g id="female_thinking" /> spoke of the source, from where the Angry Earth's lifeforce is drawn.

Title: Dowsing for Answers
Description: Communing with the mind of the Angry Earth revealed a new facet of the strange creatures.\nHelp Sun locate the sacred Angry Earth location called the Motherwell.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Ah, wait,<g id="male_handsHipsConsider" /> but this is clearly not just the waters of this region, but rather the Azoth that is undoubtedly bound to it.
InProgressResponse: To think this could all be as simple<g id="female_taptemple" /> as tracking the flow of Azoth. Let us hope!
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_nodMild" />Ah, Soulwarden, I've been waiting for your return! There<g id="male_smallSingleWave" /> is an incredible power hidden within the Ancient Towers here.

Title: The Wizard's Trial
Description: Morgaine believes that Myrddin has hidden vital secrets away somewhere within Edengrove - and has a hunch that the towers around the crater may hold the key to finding them.\nTravel with her to the towers and investigate her theory.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="female_gesturebothhands" />Precisely! My brother - fiendish<g id="male_explain" /> bastard that he could be - was also a scholar of unrivaled insight.
InProgressResponse: Myrddin definitely<g id="female_tiltheadRemember" /> hinted that time was a critical component here, so let's not waste it.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: I can't<g id="male_lookUpAround" /> believe it! That was not there a moment ago!<g id="male_convince02" /> That wizard floated a tower into the sky, then made it invisible!

Title: Myrddin's Fate
Description: Unlocking the strange devices in the towers of Edengrove revealed a tower floating above the crater, which Morgaine believes to be Myrddin's prison.\nInvestigate this strange area with Morgaine and Galahad.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Every instinct screams that I should stay, but what<g id="male_wavehandDismissive" /> kind of knight would balk at danger when so much is at stake?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: It's about time!<g id="male_headShakeNo" /> You were gone so long, I came to search and then I saw that floating tower appear in the sky! This<g id="female_touchhands" /> has something to do with Myrddin, doesn't it?

Title: The Staff of Wizardry
Description: At Myrddin's urging, the hunt begins for the headpiece of his Staff of Wizardry, a relic that could shift the balance of power in the fight against Corruption.\nTravel to the southern mines of Edengrove and locate the headpiece of the Staff.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That would<g id="male_nodUnderstand" /> be Annwn Deep...<g id="male_convince02" /> and that would explain the Corrupted massing that area!
InProgressResponse: Let me pack up here, I'll head out shortly. You have<g id="male_sighAcceptnews" /> more than enough to deal with than to wait around for me.

Title: Speaker for the Green

PlayerPrompt: "We might be able to cleanse it."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="male_headShakeNo" />Cleanse it? But what could possibly<g id="female_notsure" /> have the capability to cleanse such a powerful artifact?

Title: The Motherwell

Title: A Shadow Falls
